blocks.rationale: Aggregate the two legally distinct baggage components before arithmetic: ordinal checked-bag base fees and the per-bag higher-of-oversize-or-overweight charges. Scalar totals avoid the array-alignment failures seen in prior drafts while preserving the governing fee-combination rule.
